newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-AINTREE BIDS FOR MAXIMUM NATIONAL FIELD.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-AINTREE BIDS FOR MAXIMUM NATIONAL FIELD.

text.p: Aintree racecourse announced measures on Tuesday aimed at ensuring a maximum field of 40 for next year's Grand National by raising the top weight, easing the event's qualification restrictions and adding 50,000 pounds ($83,600) to the prize money.
Last season the race attracted only 27 runners, the smallest number since 1960.
The total value of the race will now be around 300,000 pounds ($500,000).
"Our objective is to attract class horses whilst at the same time producing a field as close as possible to the safety factor of 40," said Aintree managing director Charles Barnett.
